Question Choices: What does "frequency" mean?  (A) The size of a number.   (B) How many times something occurs   (C) The difference between numbers
Solution: Frequency means the number of times a value appears in a data set.

Question Choices: Select. Which representation is easiest to SEE the most common value?: List Frequency-table Dot-plot
Solution: On a dot plot you instantly see the tallest stack of dots — no reading numbers needed

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE. "A list, frequency table, and dot plot can show the same data.": TRUE FALSE
Solution: They represent the same data in different ways

Question Choices: Find the range of this data. Data: 14, 11, 6, 19, 3, 33, 21, 35
In a swim camp, age 6 appears 3 times, age 8 appears 5 times, age 9 appears 5 times, age 10 appears 2 times. Which two ages are most frequent?
